thread:
sam: FYI BluePraxis (BPX-442) flagged an unexpected charge on invoice INV-2026-03-17. They say onboarding promo 'bulk-onboarding-50' didn't apply for a few ingress-days (3/14-3/16). Can we review and issue an adjustment?

marta: @sam can you share which invoice line and what the expected credit would be?

sam: Sure. Invoice INV-2026-03-17 
- Line: bulk_ingest_ingress (3/14-3/16) total 12,000 units @ $0.05 = $600. Promo 50% -> expected discount = $300.

raj: Quick check of the provisioning logs shows the promo tag failed to attach on 3/14 due to a race condition in the onboarding job. Snippet: ```
2026-03-14T02:11:07Z ERROR provisioning-hook: missing promo flag for customer BPX-442 request=abc123
```

billing-bot: Created FIN-4591 to track BluePraxis retrocredit request, linked invoice INV-2026-03-17.

marta: Policy note: we issue retro promo credits when system error caused miss. For partner retention we can add a small goodwill. Recommend amount?

sam: BluePraxis is a strategic growth customer. Suggest $300 promo + $50 goodwill = $350 total credit.

emily: I can approve up to $500 for customer retention. Provide GL and short ledger justification so I can sign off.

marta: Ledger note: "Retro promo missed during provisioning; credit applied for 3/14-3/16. Promo credit $300, goodwill $50. Approved by finance lead." Use GL: SALES_RETRO_CREDITS_2026.

emily: Approved. Please generate credit memo and apply to invoice (no cash refund). :white_check_mark:

marta: Creating credit memo CM-2026-038 for $350, attaching FIN-4591 and INV-2026-03-17. Posting to ledger with GL SALES_RETRO_CREDITS_2026.

billing-bot: CM-2026-038 created and applied; invoice balance adjusted.

raj: I'll open an infra PR to add a guard to the provisioning hook and a nightly reconciliation to detect untagged promo days. Linking PR and runbook to FIN-4591.

marta: Please include runbook steps and sample query so we can evidence remediation for auditors.

sam: Customer notified; they acknowledged and appreciated the quick fix.

emily: Mark FIN-4591 as resolved once PR and runbook are attached. Good job team.

marta: FIN-4591 moved to resolved; CM-2026-038 attached and invoice notes updated. Closing loop.

sam: Thanks everyone :pray:
